Configuration.Debug: Debug configuration for Pester. ⚠ Use at your own risk!

Run.Path: Directories to be searched for tests, paths directly to test files, or combination of both. (System.String[], default: System.String[])
Run.ExcludePath: Directories or files to be excluded from the run. (System.String[], default: System.String[])
Run.ScriptBlock: ScriptBlocks containing tests to be executed. (System.Management.Automation.ScriptBlock[], default: System.Management.Automation.ScriptBlock[])
Run.Container: ContainerInfo objects containing tests to be executed. (Pester.ContainerInfo[], default: Pester.ContainerInfo[])
Run.TestExtension: Filter used to identify test files. (.Tests.ps1, default: .Tests.ps1)
Run.Exit: Exit with non-zero exit code when the test run fails. Exit code is always set to `$LASTEXITCODE` even when this option is `$false`. When used together with Throw, throwing an exception is preferred. (False, default: False)
Run.Throw: Throw an exception when test run fails. When used together with Exit, throwing an exception is preferred. (False, default: False)
Run.PassThru: Return result object to the pipeline after finishing the test run. (True, default: False)
Run.SkipRun: Runs the discovery phase but skips run. Use it with PassThru to get object populated with all tests. (False, default: False)
Run.SkipRemainingOnFailure: Skips remaining tests after failure for selected scope, options are None, Run, Container and Block. (None, default: None)

Filter.Tag: Tags of Describe, Context or It to be run. (System.String[], default: System.String[])
Filter.ExcludeTag: Tags of Describe, Context or It to be excluded from the run. (System.String[], default: System.String[])
Filter.Line: Filter by file and scriptblock start line, useful to run parsed tests programmatically to avoid problems with expanded names. Example: 'C:\tests\file1.Tests.ps1:37' (System.String[], default: System.String[])
Filter.ExcludeLine: Exclude by file and scriptblock start line, takes precedence over Line. (System.String[], default: System.String[])
Filter.FullName: Full name of test with -like wildcards, joined by dot. Example: '*.describe Get-Item.test1' (System.String[], default: System.String[])

CodeCoverage.OutputFormat: Format to use for code coverage report. Possible values: JaCoCo, CoverageGutters, Cobertura (JaCoCo, default: JaCoCo)
CodeCoverage.OutputPath: Path relative to the current directory where code coverage report is saved. (coverage.xml, default: coverage.xml)
CodeCoverage.OutputEncoding: Encoding of the output file. (UTF8, default: UTF8)
CodeCoverage.Path: Directories or files to be used for code coverage, by default the Path(s) from general settings are used, unless overridden here. (System.String[], default: System.String[])
CodeCoverage.ExcludeTests: Exclude tests from code coverage. This uses the TestFilter from general configuration. (True, default: True)
CodeCoverage.RecursePaths: Will recurse through directories in the Path option. (True, default: True)
CodeCoverage.CoveragePercentTarget: Target percent of code coverage that you want to achieve, default 75%. (75, default: 75)
CodeCoverage.UseBreakpoints: EXPERIMENTAL: When false, use Profiler based tracer to do CodeCoverage instead of using breakpoints. (True, default: True)
CodeCoverage.SingleHitBreakpoints: Remove breakpoint when it is hit. (True, default: True)

TestResult.OutputFormat: Format to use for test result report. Possible values: NUnitXml, NUnit2.5, NUnit3 or JUnitXml (NUnitXml, default: NUnitXml)
TestResult.OutputPath: Path relative to the current directory where test result report is saved. (testResults.xml, default: testResults.xml)
TestResult.OutputEncoding: Encoding of the output file. (UTF8, default: UTF8)
TestResult.TestSuiteName: Set the name assigned to the root 'test-suite' element. (Pester, default: Pester)

Should.ErrorAction: Controls if Should throws on error. Use 'Stop' to throw on error, or 'Continue' to fail at the end of the test. (Stop, default: Stop)

Debug.ShowFullErrors: Show full errors including Pester internal stack. This property is deprecated, and if set to true it will override Output.StackTraceVerbosity to 'Full'. (False, default: False)
Debug.WriteDebugMessages: Write Debug messages to screen. (False, default: False)
Debug.WriteDebugMessagesFrom: Write Debug messages from a given source, WriteDebugMessages must be set to true for this to work. You can use like wildcards to get messages from multiple sources, as well as * to get everything. (System.String[], default: System.String[])
Debug.ShowNavigationMarkers: Write paths after every block and test, for easy navigation in VSCode. (False, default: False)
Debug.ReturnRawResultObject: Returns unfiltered result object, this is for development only. Do not rely on this object for additional properties, non-public properties will be renamed without previous notice. (False, default: False)

Output.Verbosity: The verbosity of output, options are None, Normal, Detailed and Diagnostic. (Detailed, default: Normal)
Output.StackTraceVerbosity: The verbosity of stacktrace output, options are None, FirstLine, Filtered and Full. (Filtered, default: Filtered)
Output.CIFormat: The CI format of error output in build logs, options are None, Auto, AzureDevops and GithubActions. (None, default: Auto)
Output.CILogLevel: The CI log level in build logs, options are Error and Warning. (Error, default: Error)
Output.RenderMode: The mode used to render console output, options are Auto, Ansi, ConsoleColor and Plaintext. (Ansi, default: Auto)
